summary.business_type: SaaS creator-monetization platform with a blog
top_findings: Four live blog articles add the platform fee to the plan price and state a crossover point (breaks the owner's fee rule)
A public profile showing the owner's first name is indexable and in the sitemap
No third-party mentions or measurable backlinks; off-site profiles describe a different company
Page type does not match the SERP on four target queries; /patreon-alternatives is missing
Feature pages are thin and the two alternatives pages are 40% identical
quick_wins: Rewrite the four fee passages and add the pattern to the nightly rule check
Rename or unlist /@danglauber and drop it from the sitemap
Align LinkedIn, YouTube and Product Hunt descriptions before the Oct 15 launch
Wrap article tables in the scroll container
Add visually hidden text to pricing check cells and fix the Free row contradiction

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 54 sitemap URLs return 200, self-canonical, indexable
Single-hop 301 for http to https and apex to www
Real 404 with noindex
HSTS, nosniff, referrer-policy, frame options present
Server-rendered, JS deferred

findings.title: Public pages sent as no-store with a session cookie
findings.description: / and /sitemap.xml return cache-control: no-store and Set-Cookie PHPSESSID for anonymous visitors.
findings.recommendation: App: do not start a session on logged-out public routes. Owner / load balancer: then allow short caching for anonymous GETs.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod missing on 29 of 54 URLs
findings.description: Home, /features, /pricing and most hub pages have no lastmod; 15 URLs are stamped with today's date.
findings.recommendation: Emit lastmod on every URL from the real last content change; drop priority and changefreq.

findings.title: Redirect Location includes :443
findings.description: http://www.creatorlinkstudio.com/ redirects to https://www.creatorlinkstudio.com:443/.
findings.recommendation: Owner / load balancer: emit Location without the port.

findings.title: CSP is report-only; Server header exposes Apache
findings.description: All responses.
findings.recommendation: Owner: enforce CSP once reports are clean; optionally suppress the Server header.

findings.title: Weak internal links to a few pages
findings.description: /creators/beauty has 1 inbound link; /blog/ai-chat-for-creators 3.
findings.recommendation: Cross-link from related posts and feature pages.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Compare pages are sourced and dated
Bias disclosed on list pages
Editorial process and corrections route published on /about
Low verbatim duplication between articles
Readability Flesch 57 to 81

findings.title: Four live articles add the fee to the plan price and state a crossover point
findings.description: Verified live: /blog/how-to-choose-an-onlyfans-alternative ('the answer sits near $2,143 of monthly sales. Above that level the pricier plan starts covering itself'), /blog/how-to-monetize-content-as-a-creator ('$300 plus $49, which is $349, against $90 plus $199, which is $289'), /blog/custom-ai-influencer-training-when-to-invest ('Creator costs $200 in fees plus $49, so $249'), /blog/how-to-pick-a-creator-monetization-platform.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite the four passages and their leads and meta descriptions: fee as a percentage of sales alone, plan price as a separate line, no crossover. Add the pattern to the nightly rule check.

findings.title: A public profile shows the owner's first name and is in the sitemap
findings.description: Verified live: /@danglauber is titled 'DanGlauber (@danglauber) · Creator Link Studio', is indexable, listed in sitemap.xml, 69 words, bio 'this is my bio page'.
findings.recommendation: Rename or unlist the test profile and keep empty profiles out of the sitemap.

findings.title: /onlyfans-alternatives and /fanvue-alternatives are 40% identical
findings.description: 48 of 96 sentences identical (604 of 1,505 words).
findings.recommendation: Make at least 60% of each specific to the platform being left; keep the 12-row fee table on one page.

findings.title: Feature and AI landing pages are thin
findings.description: 9 /features/* pages run 406 to 638 words; /lora-character-training 476, /consistent-ai-model-face 442, /ai-ofm-tools 474.
findings.recommendation: Add per-plan limits, setup steps, the fan-side view, edge cases and feature-specific questions.

findings.title: Articles show no first-hand experience; author expertise is off-topic
findings.description: 14 articles in 20 days, no first-party data or images in any body; author bio is cybersecurity only; Person sameAs is empty.
findings.recommendation: Add real first-party material, one true topic-relevant line on the author page, drop the empty sameAs, slow the cadence.

findings.title: Plan-facts paragraph repeated in every article
findings.description: '$49' in 14 of 14 bodies, '25 GB' in 13 of 14.
findings.recommendation: Remove where the article is not about plans; link to /pricing.

findings.title: Thin, recycled citation pool
findings.description: 12 unique external URLs across 14 articles; generic help roots used as sources.
findings.recommendation: Cite the specific page for the specific claim.

findings.title: dateModified bulk-set to today on all 14 articles
findings.description: Three batches at 12:21, 13:08 and 13:56 UTC on 2026-10-12, no visible update date.
findings.recommendation: Change dateModified only on substantive edits; print an Updated date.

findings.title: Invented creator not labelled as an example
findings.description: /blog/ai-chat-for-creators: 'The yoga creator finished the fortnight with 140 messages'.
findings.recommendation: Label it as a made-up example at first mention.

findings.title: Unsupported 'most creators' claims
findings.description: 12 sentences site-wide, including FAQ schema on /compare/onlyfans.
findings.recommendation: Phrase as advice or cite data.

findings.title: Refund wording conflicts with the final-sale policy
findings.description: /features/payouts: 'Refunds and disputes are handled for you'; /monetize-your-content: 'a refund you choose to give a fan'.
findings.recommendation: Describe only what happens to the creator's balance if a sale is reversed.

findings.title: /pricing contradicts itself on Free
findings.description: Free card says 'Your public page at your handle: Included'; the Compare Plans table shows a dash for Free on the same row; FAQ says Free is for fans.
findings.recommendation: Align the table and FAQ with the card.

findings.title: 'Most popular' badge has no basis
findings.description: /pricing Creator card.
findings.recommendation: Remove or use a factual label.

findings.title: Softer crossover wording on commercial pages
findings.description: /best-creator-monetization-platforms: 'a share of 20% starts to cost more than a plan price plus a smaller share'.
findings.recommendation: Owner to decide; rewrite as two separate facts.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: No duplicate titles or descriptions
One H1 on every page
0 images missing alt across 54 pages
Definition-first openings

findings.title: No hub page links to any blog article
findings.description: 0 contextual links from features, pricing, compare, alternatives, best-of, monetize or AI pages to the 14 articles.
findings.recommendation: Add in-body related guides per hub, chosen by topic (mapping in findings/cluster.md).

findings.title: Fanvue and OnlyFans head terms each targeted by two URLs
findings.description: /fanvue-alternatives vs /blog/fanvue-alternative; /onlyfans-alternatives vs /blog/how-to-choose-an-onlyfans-alternative.
findings.recommendation: Hub owns the head term; retitle the articles to the switching angle and cross-link.

findings.title: Page type does not match the SERP on four targets
findings.description: 'lora character training' ranks tutorials, ours is a 472-word feature page; 'ai influencer generator' ranks tool pages; 'patreon alternative' ranks list pages and /patreon-alternatives is 404; 'creator monetization platform' ranks listicles, not home pages.
findings.recommendation: Target the tutorial article for the LoRA term; retitle the AI page to 'AI Influencer Generator'; build /patreon-alternatives; make the best-of page the target for the platform term.

findings.title: Competitor cards on alternatives pages are identical one-liners
findings.description: Same sentence for Fansly, Fanvue, LoyalFans and JustFor.Fans.
findings.recommendation: Use the sourced, dated fields already held for compare pages.

findings.title: Footer and dialog titles are H2s; H2 larger than H1 on home and pricing
findings.description: Every page carries 9 non-content H2s; home H1 32px vs H2 48px.
findings.recommendation: Make footer and dialog titles non-heading elements; set one H1 size.

findings.title: Free tools have no contextual links in or out
findings.description: /tools/ai-influencer-persona and /tools/fan-questions.
findings.recommendation: Link from the matching feature pages and articles.

findings.title: Compare meta descriptions share one templated ending
findings.description: All 9 end '...from one page. Fees compared.'
findings.recommendation: Write each from that page's distinguishing fact.

findings.title: Title and description length edges
findings.description: /compare/stan title 61 characters; /about 179 and /founding 180 character descriptions; one article description ends mid-sentence.
findings.recommendation: Trim and repair.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid JSON-LD everywhere, no deprecated types
Home uses a linked @graph
Articles carry author, publisher, dates, breadcrumb
No Review or AggregateRating anywhere

findings.title: Inner pages are not linked to the home graph
findings.description: Every inner page declares its own Organization and WebSite with no @id.
findings.recommendation: One #org and #website node, referenced by @id from every page.

findings.title: Article has no @id and duplicates the Organization twice
findings.description: mainEntityOfPage is a bare URL; full Organization inside publisher and author.worksFor.
findings.recommendation: Emit WebPage, Article and BreadcrumbList in one @graph with @id references.

findings.title: Author Person has empty sameAs and no image
findings.description: /author/dr-glauber and every Article author.
findings.recommendation: Drop the empty array or fill with real profiles.

findings.title: Pricing offers lack availability and a monthly price specification
findings.description: /pricing: 4 Offers with name, price, currency only.
findings.recommendation: Add availability and UnitPriceSpecification with billingDuration P1M.

findings.title: SoftwareApplication redefined on three pages
findings.description: /, /features, /pricing with differing names.
findings.recommendation: One #software node on home, referenced elsewhere.

findings.title: No dateModified on pricing, compare and list pages
findings.description: WebPage JSON-LD has no dates.
findings.recommendation: Add dateModified equal to the latest source-check date and a visible 'Last checked' line.

findings.title: Crunchbase and G2 sameAs links unverified
findings.description: Both return 403 to automated fetch.
findings.recommendation: Confirm in a browser; remove any that do not exist.

findings.title: TikTok sameAs handle
findings.description: One agent found tiktok.com/@creatorlinkstudio missing; another read it as live with 0 followers. Conflicting, so unverified.
findings.recommendation: Open it in a browser and correct the footer and sameAs if needed.

findings.title: FAQPage present on 9 of 16 pages
findings.description: No Google rich result since May 2026.
findings.recommendation: No action.

categories.name: Performance (CWV, lab)
what_works: All six measured pages pass lab LCP, CLS and TBT
HTML 13 to 15 KB compressed
Text is the LCP element on four of six pages
Self-hosted font preloaded, no font shift
Analytics scripts are async

findings.title: Analytics scripts cost about 315 KB and drive mobile TBT
findings.description: gtag 179 KB, HeyCatch SDK 108 KB via esm.sh, Clarity 25 KB; mobile TBT 86 to 141 ms.
findings.recommendation: Load them after the load event or on first interaction; self-host the HeyCatch SDK.

findings.title: Bootstrap, jQuery and toastr load on public pages
findings.description: About 66 KB over 4 requests from jsDelivr.
findings.recommendation: Unverified which public elements need them; load only where required.

findings.title: Compare hero background image discovered late
findings.description: /compare/patreon mobile LCP 2084 ms vs FCP 1222 ms.
findings.recommendation: Preload the image and preconnect to the S3 host.

findings.title: Article cover LCP 2038 ms on slow mobile
findings.description: /blog/ai-chat-for-creators.
findings.recommendation: Preconnect to S3 and preload the cover.

findings.title: Three render-blocking first-party stylesheets
findings.description: landing.css, sx.css (83 KB decoded), public.css.
findings.recommendation: Merge and defer non-critical CSS.

findings.title: gzip, not brotli; no immutable on versioned assets
findings.description: First-party CSS and JS.
findings.recommendation: Owner / load balancer.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: No AI crawler blocked; identical HTML served to all
llms.txt and llms-full.txt present and accurate
Definition leads and direct answers
Sourced, dated competitor data
Agent-UX heuristic 92/100; all controls named and labelled

findings.title: No third-party mentions of the brand
findings.description: A brand search returns only the site's own home page; not in the Common Crawl graph; no referring domains verifiable.
findings.recommendation: Use the 2026-10-15 Product Hunt launch as the first corroboration event; earn editorial links. Nothing invented, no paid links.

findings.title: Off-site profiles describe a different company
findings.description: LinkedIn: 'a digital platform designed to help content creators, influencers, and entrepreneurs build their brands', industry Marketing Services; YouTube and Product Hunt taglines differ too.
findings.recommendation: Paste the canonical one-sentence description into every profile before launch; change the LinkedIn industry.

findings.title: Pricing table check cells have no text
findings.description: Cells are an svg with aria-label only, so the table extracts empty.
findings.recommendation: Add visually hidden 'Included' text.

findings.title: Home has no 'What Is Creator Link Studio?' block; FAQ answers are 8 to 15 words
findings.recommendation: Add a 2 to 3 sentence self-contained block; expand the short answers.

findings.title: Lighthouse Agentic Browsing score not obtained
findings.description: PageSpeed Insights returned 429 with no API key.
findings.recommendation: Re-run with a Google API key.

findings.title: MCP server not discoverable
findings.description: /.well-known/mcp.json and ai-catalog.json return 404.
findings.recommendation: Optional: publish a discovery file.

findings.title: Home live feed puts a creator caption on the entity page
findings.description: 'strap came undone again, pretend you didn't see'.
findings.recommendation: Owner decision: limit the feed to featured or SFW posts.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All raster images WebP, charts SVG
Every audited image has alt and dimensions
Below-fold images lazy, article cover eager

findings.title: Article comparison table clipped on phones
findings.description: /blog/best-ai-tools-consistent-ai-influencer-characters at 390px: the 4th column cannot be scrolled to.
findings.recommendation: Wrap article tables in the scroll container used on /pricing.

findings.title: Wide tables hide paid columns on phones with no scroll cue
findings.description: /pricing table is 640px in a 344px wrapper.
findings.recommendation: Add an edge fade or sticky first column.

findings.title: Related-article thumbnails oversized
findings.description: 480x360 shown at 88x66.
findings.recommendation: Add small variants with srcset.

findings.title: Emoji in an image alt text on home
findings.description: Home demo image.
findings.recommendation: Remove the emoji.

findings.title: Small tap targets on mobile
findings.description: Footer social links 20px tall; 'source' links 16 to 20px.
findings.recommendation: Minimum 44px height.

phases.name: Phase 1: Rule Breaches and Launch Prep
items: Verify Crunchbase, G2, TikTok and X profiles; remove dead sameAs links
Fix /pricing Free row and refund wording

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Single Organization and WebSite @id graph on all pages
Hub pages link to their articles; retitle the two overlapping articles
Sourced competitor cards on alternatives pages; differentiate the two alternatives pages
Article table scroll wrapper; pricing check-cell text; demote footer and dialog H2s
lastmod on every sitemap URL; dateModified and 'Last checked' on commercial pages

phases.name: Phase 3: Content and Authority
items: Expand the 12 thin feature and AI pages
Build /patreon-alternatives; retarget LoRA and AI generator terms
First-party data in articles; slow the cadence
Defer analytics scripts; stop sessions on public pages

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring and Iteration
items: Add a Google API key for field data and the Lighthouse agentic score
Capture a drift baseline after the fixes ship
